Class HardwareRendererNatives

java.lang.Object

    • nSetFrameCompleteCallback

      public static void nSetFrameCompleteCallback(long nativeProxy, HardwareRenderer.FrameCompleteCallback callback)
      Retained for JNI registration by the prebuilt librobolectric-nativeruntime.so on SDKs 29-34 (<= UPSIDE_DOWN_CAKE), even though ShadowNativeHardwareRenderer no longer calls it. FrameCompleteCallback was removed from HardwareRenderer after SDK 37 (CINNAMON_BUN); once nativeruntime compiles against an SDK > 37, nativeruntime will need to compile against SDK 34 (U) or include a compileOnly stub for android.graphics.HardwareRenderer$FrameCompleteCallback.
